desc: 短板3防复发闸（2026-08-20 REFORM-GATE 判A，块文件 ~/.agents/logs/reform_gate_block_recurrence_gates_20260820.md）：StateStore 双写接线差集核验——backend 下直接写实例状态（instance/inst/flow_instance.status =）的非测试文件必须引用 state_wiring 收口，差集非空即判 B。2026-08-20 校准基线：候选扫描仅 orchestrator.py 且已接线，零差集。挂点：agent-harness 代码交付复盘期。

checks.cmd: cd ~/agent-harness/backend && misses=$(for f in $(grep -rEl --include='*.py' '(instance|inst|flow_instance)\.status\s*=' . 2>/dev/null | grep -vE 'test|\.bak|state_store|state_wiring'); do grep -L 'state_wiring' "$f"; done); if [ -n "$misses" ]; then echo "WIRING-DIFF: 判B——以下文件直写实例状态但未接 state_wiring："; echo "$misses"; exit 2; fi; echo 'WIRING-DIFF: PASS 零差集'
checks.label: 实例状态直写文件全部经 state_wiring 收口（零差集）
